subject: SprintGate launch: capacity checkpoint & temporary rate window request
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nebula.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: launchops@nebula.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SprintGate launch - expected traffic profile + ask

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Quick follow-up as we finalize our launch cadence: our product team expects two traffic spikes in week 1 — a soft beta on Day 2 (~1.2M tokens/day) and the public launch on Day 6 (~4.8M tokens/day) with most API calls clustered in three 90-minute windows. We need to confirm temporary entitlement for a higher ingress window and a short-term quota increase to avoid 429s during those bursts.

Attached is our latest traffic model (sprintgate_traffic_model_v2.xlsx) and a one-page summary of the requested temporary window. Can you confirm what you need from our side to get a short-term rate uplift and the typical lead time? Also copy-contracts; we may need a brief amendment if costs change.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — launch date is 2027-04-15.

Best,
Sarah Li
Head of Product Operations
Nebula AI

Attachment: sprintgate_traffic_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: temporary_rate_window_request.pdf (pdf)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nebula.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, contracts@nebula.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SprintGate launch - expected traffic profile + ask

Sarah — thanks for the model and timeline. I'm looping in Priyom (sales lead) and David (SRE/product infra) to scope out the entitlement and the safe short-term rate window. High-level plan:

- Prio A: confirm daily/peak qps and token distribution (we'll validate against model sheet)
- Prio B: SRE to provision temporary burst headroom and routing carve-outs to avoid latency regressions
- Prio C: commercial note — we typically bill overage pro rata for short windows; Contracts, please advise if Nebula needs an amendment.

Prio list for internal: Priyom, can you draft a temporary entitlement that matches the Day 6 spike and propose a burst cap? David — can SRE support a 2x baseline headroom during the two 90-min windows? Tessa, please flag any console/observability changes we should auto-enable for the window.

I'll coordinate sign-off with Sarah once we have a proposed window and cost delta.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@nebula.ai>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SprintGate launch - expected traffic profile + ask

Team / Sarah,

I pulled the numbers from Sarah's spreadsheet and drafted the temporary entitlement request. Summary:
- Baseline: 800k tokens/day (current trial baseline)
- Beta Day 2 peak: 1.2M tokens (90-min concentrated window)
- Day 6 public launch peak: 4.8M tokens (three 90-min windows across the day)

Proposal: grant a temporary "burst window" for Day 6 of +3.2M tokens for a 12-hour rolling window centered on the first public spike, with automatic rollback to baseline after 24 hours. For Day 2, a one-off +400k tokens for a 4-hour window. Estimated incremental cost (list price) for burst capacity: $1,650 (Day 2) + $7,200 (Day 6) = $8,850.

I attached a one-page temporary_rate_window_request.pdf (draft) to be formalized by Contracts if Nebula confirms.

Next steps:
- David: confirm if SRE can carve reserved capacity or if we need routing fallbacks to model variants.
- Tessa: enable extended observability (token-level tracing, spike alerting) for 48 hours.
- Sarah: can you confirm the exact UTC windows for Day 2 and Day 6? We need that to set the entitlement windows accurately.

Thanks,
—Priyom
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: temporary_rate_window_request.pdf (draft)

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@nebula.ai>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 13:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SprintGate launch - expected traffic profile + ask

Quick infra check: we can support the proposed burst profile but with these caveats:
1) Reserved carve-out: we can reserve a pool of dedicated capacity for the 12-hour Day 6 window but it requires a short notice provisioning (we have spare Dedicated nodes in us-west) and a manual routing policy for those tokens. Lead time: 36 hours to configure and validate.
2) Auto-fallback: recommended to configure fallback to a quantized variant for non-critical endpoints to prevent 429s if the reserved pool saturates.
3) Observability: we can enable token-level tracing and synthetic probing for the three 90-min windows; however, alerts will need fine-tuning to avoid alert fatigue.

Operational ask for Nebula: provide the UTC start times for Day 2 and Day 6 and confirm whether the three 90-min windows are contiguous or spread across the day (sheet shows spread at 02:00, 10:30, 18:00 UTC). If you confirm by EOD, we can meet the provisioning lead time for Day 6.

-D
David Kim
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@nebula.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, contracts@nebula.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SprintGate launch - expected traffic profile + ask

Thanks all — confirmed windows below (UTC):
- Beta Day 2: 2027-04-17 15:00–19:00 UTC (one 4-hour concentrated window)
- Public Day 6: 2027-04-21 windows: 02:00–03:30, 10:30–12:00, 18:00–19:30 UTC

Acknowledged the estimated incremental cost ($8,850). Contracts: please advise on the short amendment; we can sign a simple addendum for the temporary window if needed.

Olga/Priyom/David — please go ahead with provisioning and the routing plan. Tessa — happy to enable any debugging tokens and provide access to our internal dashboards for synthetic checks.

We'll stand by for the final entitlement notice and the invoice. Appreciate the quick coordination — big launch for us.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Product Operations, Nebula AI
